author: GREG ISENBERG
text:
I've noticed recently that every big trend sparks an equally big  "anti-trend"

- 24/7 connectivity to digital detox retreats
- VC backed businesses to boring businesses
- Fast fashion to sustainable clothing  
- Hustle culture to slow living  

It's like, whenever something gets really popular, there's this natural pull towards the other end of the spectrum

While everyone is busy trying to find gold in the zigging, the savvy few discover real treasures in the zagging of the anti-trend.
